channel.title: Project Planar Player's Guide
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Project Planar Player's Guide

item.title: Warlock Aaranea
item.description: Your patron is Lilien, the Archdevil of Desire, or Gwenhael, the Archangel of Sacrifice. They were Aaranea, The Lover, whose act was to love.

item.title: Warlock Baator
item.description: Your patron is Belphegor, the Archdevil of Indulgence, or Blythe, the Archangel of Temperance. They were Baator, The Xenia, whose act was to host.

item.title: Warlock Charios
item.description: Your patron is Lux, the Archdevil of Pride, or Pavlas, the Archangel of Humility. They were Charios, The Entertainer, whose act was to perform.

item.title: Warlock Hesit
item.description: Your patron is Abaddon, the Archdevil of Cruelty, or Neema, the Archangel of Kindness.

item.title: Warlock Sylas
item.description: Your patron is Tiyanak, the Archdevil of Deceit, or Verita, the Archangel of Truth. They were Sylas, The Poet, whose act was to compose verse.

item.title: Warlock Judgements
item.description: Your patron is one of the twelve: an archdevil or an archangel.

item.title: Warlock Themati
item.description: Your patron is Archon, the Archdevil of Tyranny, or Themis, the Archangel of Justice. They were Themati, The King of Kings, whose act was to rule.

item.title: 473 Hekate
item.description: 473 · Hekate Hekate is the ascendant god of Magic.

item.title: 170 Elementals
item.description: 170 · Elementals The Progenitor named Genasi made the elementals with help from the dragons, and took the five elemental realms of Tarkis as the model.

item.title: 180 Earthborn
item.description: 180 · Earthborn Talav made the earthborn. Gnomes, dwarves, and halflings, all three playable.
